name: application-compact-data-table
title: Compact Data Table
description: High-density zebra-striped table with a condensed row height and a sticky header, for scanning many rows in a fixed-height scroll panel.
useWhen: Displaying many rows of simple tabular data in a constrained-height panel, such as an inventory or lookup list.
Row density matters more than spacious readability — the user is scanning, not reading in depth.
A sticky header is needed so column labels stay visible while scrolling a long row list.
avoidWhen: The table needs sortable columns, row selection, or inline actions — use application-tables or application-data-grid-cell-editor instead.
Rows contain rich content (avatars, multi-line text, badges) — condensed row height will feel cramped; use application-tables instead.
The dataset is short enough to fit without scrolling — the sticky header and scroll container add no value.
responsiveBehavior: The table sits in a fixed max-width, max-height scroll container; the header stays pinned via position: sticky while the body scrolls. Columns do not reflow at smaller widths — enable horizontal scroll on the outer container if needed.
accessibility: Column headers use scope="col" so screen readers announce the correct header for each cell.
Zebra striping is a visual aid only; row content itself does not rely on color to convey meaning.
The sticky header remains keyboard-scrollable along with the body via native scroll behavior.

variants.title: Sticky header, dense rows
variants.description: Zebra-striped table with condensed row height and a sticky header inside a scrollable panel.
accessibility: Header cells use scope="col" for correct screen-reader association with body cells.

variants.title: Sticky header, dense rows (Dark)
variants.description: Compact data table adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Zebra row and header contrast meet WCAG AA against the dark panel background.
